journey.title: A weekend that felt like living again
journey.text: Blackpool with Jason, Eve, Mum and Dad became much more than a trip in the diary. We travelled together, laughed, ate well, watched the Illuminations and fireworks, had afternoon tea in the Tower Ballroom, finally made it up Blackpool Tower after the wind cancellation, went to Funny Girls and finished with a family detour to Uncle Alfie on the way home. The strongest thing about the weekend was how much enjoyment, connection and ordinary life there was in it. I came home thinking simply: what a great weekend.

journey.title: The final stretch with Kirsty
journey.text: The previous homework was dropped because Kirsty and I agreed it was not relevant and I had not properly understood it. The new exercise is Observing the Stream: step back from thoughts for a couple of minutes, notice how they show up and let them carry on without fighting them. There is one final Kirsty session left. The formal therapy journey is nearly finished, but the useful logging and check-ins will continue afterwards.
